items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: I didn't know Robert Junior that day when you started. No. Robert Junior wasn't even talking about, did you?

ctx.x: I, uh, never was impressed with him like I was with the boys last time. How much water did you want?

Uh, some of the old timers like Bill and, uh, Robert Johnson and some of them like that, you know, and, uh, the real Sonnen. Boy, I never did, uh, I know of Keg House, but I know of Keg House, but I know of the boy I made the milk house, you know, and a whole lot of Kegs.

I don't want to wear out my wealth on the first day. I don't want to move here. Yeah, you know, I know of Kegs when I'm dragging the trackers, but I'm trying to get everybody else supposed to do the things.
